    """Parse a list (ordered or unordered)."""
    marker = m.group('list_2')
    
    # Determine if ordered or unordered list
    if marker[0] in '+-*':
        list_type = 'bullet_list'
        bullet = marker

        list_type = 'ordered_list'

    # Transform tight lists
